summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting its Orchestra launch event held on May 28, 2026. The filing announces a new wearable AI product called "Orchestra," described as a portable external brain for the human body, and provides technical details about its architecture, compute module, and protocol. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation corporate events (e.g., acquisitions, divestitures, going-private, etc.) are disclosed. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer announcing a product launch, with no M&A, capital markets, or restructuring activity. As such, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situation category.
